title: Classroom Volunteer Checklist
subtitle: Capture class assignment, approved task, student boundary, and screening status; confirm supervision and badge return.
description: Classroom Volunteer records class assignment, approved task, student boundary, screening status, supervision, and badge return. Classroom Volunteer evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this classroom volunteer stage-gated verification when staff must document class assignment and approved task. Reconcile student boundary, screening status, supervision, and badge return before the classroom volunteer handoff. Use the screening clearance reference, classroom calendar, task brief, confidentiality acknowledgment, supervising-teacher assignment, badge log, and departure record. Ask the assigned classroom volunteer reviewer to confirm class assignment against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Classroom Volunteer starting details
sections.guidance: Define classroom assignment, approved tasks, student-contact boundaries, screening status, supervising teacher, badge custody, and departure.

sections.title: Classroom Volunteer exception review: checks and corrections
sections.guidance: Check current classroom volunteer facts at point of use.

blocks.label: Classroom Volunteer required checks
items: Class assignment is identified for this record
Approved task matches the current request or source
Student boundary is ready for point-of-use staff
Screening status limits or questions are resolved
Supervision is communicated to the responsible person
Badge return is confirmed at handoff

sections.title: Classroom Volunteer readiness and handoff
sections.guidance: Hold classroom volunteer readiness on any failed or pending item.
